note: Assumptions only, no human data (SAP v1 sections 5, 6, 9). The joint part reuses the SBP and DBP targets and models of rq1_sensitivity_v2.json unchanged; rho is the assumed correlation between every matching SBP and DBP random term (0 = independent outcomes; 0.6 = an invented, plausible value). The LOSO part invents a feature model (gains, drift and noise in feature SD units); the numbers are scenarios, not estimates. Joint scenarios are [M2, SBP model, DBP model]; the mixed ones (one outcome null) check the second Holm step. The feature baseline is measured with noise (mean of the two session-1 M0 cuffs, as BP0). theta of the LOSO part comes from a separate simulation of theta_replicates studies. 'hr_ppg' only marks the M2 maneuver, so PPG-only can beat zero-change without tracking BP (SAP section 13).
